subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for toolProgress and commandText, and should channels.feishu.streaming remain protected from agent-facing config.patch writes?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the repair changes Feishu's public config surface and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, which requires maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior, and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only soften progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce scary command failure wording, which is smaller but still leaves no Feishu way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Allow agent-facing config.patch to change channels.feishu.streaming, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and still lacks status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior, and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu CardKit streaming path and current boolean streaming config surface that this decision would extend.
